title: Preconditioning for Diffuse Interface Tumor Growth Models
summary: Computational models of tumor growth form a contemporary area of study. Diffuse interface models have been proposed as an important tool for cancer modeling. In this work, we consider preconditioners for numerical simulations of two tumor growth models based on diffuse interface models. For numerical efficiency, we propose block preconditioners that rely on using effective Schur-complement approximations.
